name: EMNIST
description: Handwritten character classification dataset with ByClass, Balanced, Merged, Digits, and Letters variants (62/47-class). Use is subject to NIST terms. No data is vendored in this repository.
citation: Cohen, G., Afshar, S., Tapson, J., & van Schaik, A. (2017). EMNIST: an extension of MNIST to handwritten letters. NIST release.

license.notes: Use and redistribution are subject to NIST terms; no standard SPDX license identifier is stated here.
